criteria.text: The profile page displays the user's name and email address.
Users can edit their profile information.
The page includes a Set Chore Preferences section.
The page includes a Set Household Manager Preferences section.
Users can save changes to their profile and preferences.
User Action: The user opens their profile page. Expected System Behavior: The system displays their current profile information and saved preferences.
User Action: The user edits their name and clicks Save. Expected System Behavior: The system saves the updated information and displays: “Profile updated successfully.”
User Action: The user clicks Cancel while editing. Expected System Behavior: The system discards unsaved changes.
User Action: The user opens the Chore Preferences section. Expected System Behavior: The system displays available chore preferences for the user to select.
User Action: The user selects or updates their chore preferences and clicks Save. Expected System Behavior: The system saves the selected preferences and displays a confirmation message.
User Action: The user opens the Household Manager Preferences section. Expected System Behavior: The system displays available preferences related to how household chores are managed.
User Action: The user updates their preferences and clicks Save. Expected System Behavior: The system saves the preferences and displays a confirmation message.
Error Condition: The user's name is left blank. Expected Message: “Name is required.”
Error Condition: The user tries to save preferences but the update fails. Expected Message: “Changes not saved. Please try again.”
Error Condition: The user cancels while editing. Expected Behavior: Unsaved changes are discarded, and previously saved information remains unchanged.
